title: SALT: When More Rollouts Don't Help in Group-Based Policy Optimization and How to Make Them Matter
abstract: arXiv:2606.05800v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often adopts GRPO-style group-relative updates, sampling multiple rollouts per prompt to construct normalized learning signals. However, merely increasing the number of rollouts does not reliably strengthen learning: under GRPO-style group normalization, per-rollout policy-gradient features can concentrate into a low-rank, signed geometry, causing substantial cancellation during aggregation and weakening the effective update. We address this failure mode with SALT, a Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT that uses sample-wise gradient geometry to reweight the coefficients of group-relative updates. SALT estimates a dominant shared subspace from the mini-batch Gram geometry, decomposes group-relative coefficients into shared and residual channels, and adaptively amplifies the residual channel when signed cancellation is severe. translated_title: SALT：当更多采样在基于分组的策略优化中失效时，如何让它们发挥作用
translated_abstract: 采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通常采用GRPO风格的组相对更新，即为每个提示采样多个rollout来构建归一化的学习信号。然而，仅仅增加rollout的数量并不能可靠地增强学习效果：在GRPO风格的组归一化下，每个rollout的策略梯度特征可能集中到一种低秩的带符号几何结构中，导致聚合过程中出现大量相互抵消，从而削弱了有效更新。我们通过SALT来解决这一失效模式——SALT是一个子空间自适应几何插件组件，利用逐样本的梯度几何来重新加权组相对更新的系数。SALT从小批量的Gram几何中估计出一个主导共享子空间，将组相对系数分解为共享通道和残差通道，并在带符号抵消严重时自适应地放大残差通道。在多样化的面向推理的RLVR基准上……
tldr: 论文揭示了GRPO式组归一化中增加rollout数量会因策略梯度特征聚集成低秩带符号几何而相互抵消，并提出SALT插件，通过样本级梯度几何将组相对系数分解为共享与残差通道并自适应放大残差通道，使更多rollout真正发挥作用。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that adding more rollouts under GRPO-style group normalization fails because policy-gradient features collapse into a low-rank signed geometry causing cancellation, and proposes SALT, a subspace-adaptive plug-in that decomposes group-relative coefficients into shared and residual channels and adaptively amplifies the residual channel to make rollouts matter.
